title: Btrfs/ZFS/bcachefs under workloads classic benchmarks skip
summary: A technical benchmark comparison of three modern copy-on-write filesystems (Btrfs, ZFS, bcachefs) under traditional filesystem benchmark workloads, questioning whether classic benchmarks adequately measure modern storage scenarios.
problem_solved: Evaluates whether traditional filesystem benchmarks accurately represent real-world performance for modern CoW filesystems.
why_valuable: Provides empirical performance data to help system administrators and developers choose the right filesystem for their specific workload requirements.
